title: the_intern_who_streamed_my_run
display_title: My company's new intern livestreamed my private parkour run to 40,000 people
beats: My company's 22-year-old intern found my private parkour account and livestreamed my run to his 40,000 followers without asking.
I only found out because my phone wouldn't stop buzzing during a meeting — my username, my face-free voice, all live.
Turns out he'd been mirroring my screen from the shared office monitor for 'content,' three sessions deep before I caught it.
I told HR, he got a written warning, and he told our whole team I was 'stealing his growth' by getting mad.
Half my coworkers now call me dramatic for a 40,000-person invasion of something I never once made public. So, Reddit... AITAH?
